notes.title: Update content for February 28th: New synchronization achievement function added
notes.content:
Dear doctors, the latest update announcement is as follows:

1. Added a synchronization achievement button, which can be used to detect and synchronize Steam achievements, solving the problem of achieving achievements in the game but not triggering Steam achievements

2. Optimized the detailed experience

Official QQ group: [b]869659334[/b]

Welcome to join the QQ group. Feel free to give feedback to our assistant if you have any questions~
Wishing everyone a pleasant trip!

notes.title: Update content for August 2nd: Added keyboard controls
notes.content:
[b]Update content for August 2nd: Added keyboard controls[/b]

Dear Dr. Chatelet, in order to facilitate you in performing bloodletting and amputation surgeries, and save more patients, we have added keyboard controls.

1、Bloodletting treatment can now be controlled using the space bar on your keyboard for preparation and making the incision;

2、For amputation surgeries, use the A/D keys on your keyboard to control the amputation.

Official QQ Group: [b]869659334[/b]

Everyone is welcome to join the QQ group, and feel free to report any issues to the assistant at any time.

Hope you all have a great gaming experience!

notes.title: Dr. Chatelet: Faith - Spring Sale at 15% Off, hurry!
notes.content:
Dr. Chatelet: Faith - Spring Sale at 15% Off, hurry!
Offer ends on the 24th.
Doctors, hurry up!

1.New Experience Mode
In addition to the original ‘Normal Mode’, a more accessible ‘Experience Mode’ is added for ultra-casual players to enjoy the game and story without obstacles.

2.New Mini-Game Challenge Mode
After completing the first round, you can unlock the Mini-Game Challenge Mode for endless limb amputations, bloodletting, and medication.

3.Additional Ending Story Content
Important endings have been supplemented, completing the life trajectories of Dr. Chatelet and his companions.

4.30+ Steam Achievements

5.Easter Eggs
Included in the root directory of "Miracle Doctor" are virtual gifts like the "Miracle Doctor CG Collection." You can find the game CG and other gifts in the ★GIFT★ folder in your Steam directory.
(Address: Steam\steamapps\common\Dr. Chatelet Faith Miracle Doctor)

Doctors, hurry up and start amputating!
If you encounter any issues during gameplay, join the group chat: 869659334.
All doctors are welcome to join; our little assistant is waiting for you in the group chat!
